hook: Three days before he died in a Pakistani jail, an Indian prisoner wrote home: "Had I been an American, I would have been out of this jail in three days." Episode 3 of RAW Files follows Ravindra Kaushik, the man India calls the Black Tiger — from a college stage in Sri Ganganagar, through Project X and a cover life in Pakistan, to sixteen years in Pakistani custody and the family's fight for one line of recognition.
promise: Built from The Telegraph's 2002 report, Hindustan Times, The Pioneer, Times of India and ThePrint's 2023 investigation. Where the family's account and R&AW officers' account differ — his rank, the "Black Tiger" title — both are given.
disclaimer: This is an explanatory documentary based on published reporting. R&AW's file on Ravindra Kaushik has not been declassified; claims resting only on his family are labelled as such. No licence-clean photograph of him exists; he is shown as a silhouette.
pinned: Episode 3 of 10. Next: B. Raman, the counter-terrorism chief who became RAW's chronicler. Sources for every claim are in the description.
